name: Codex
summary: OpenAI's coding agent, available as the Codex CLI, an IDE extension, and Codex in the ChatGPT desktop app and on the web.

skills.what: Agent skills built on the open agent skills standard, available standalone in the ChatGPT desktop app, Codex CLI and IDE extension.

mcp.what: MCP servers over STDIO (a local process) or Streamable HTTP.

plugins.what: Plugins that bundle skills and MCP servers, packaged with a root plugin.json declaring the Agent Plugins schema, or the older .codex-plugin/plugin.json kept as a fallback; the IDE extension doesn't support plugins.

hooks.what: Hooks run scripts or MCP tools during the Codex agent loop, at events such as PreToolUse and PostToolUse; enabled plugins can bundle hooks.

scheduled-work.what: Scheduled tasks run recurring work in the background, created and managed from the ChatGPT desktop app or the web; Codex CLI and the IDE extension don't provide the Scheduled interface.

sandboxes.what: The sandbox runs the agent's commands in the ChatGPT desktop app, Codex CLI and IDE extension inside a constrained environment enforced natively on each OS.
